verdict.rationale: RingCentral's developer guide documents User Call Handling with State-based Rules (e.g., business vs. after-hours states), Call Handling Configurations, and Call Forwarding Targets, which is the core capability for forwarding the business number elsewhere when the team is away. The product is also pitched as handling calls on any device, including Android and iOS. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of forwarding to an external cell number (the evidence is only navigation headings), and no hands-on or independent corroboration of the forwarding setup.
